plays.description: Opening kick results in a touchback; the captions do not identify the kicking team or returner.
After a fake to Robinson, Rush scrambles and fumbles. Carolina recovers; review upholds the ruling. DB identifies Z. Wheatley as forcing the fumble and Nick Scott as recovering.
plays.defender_beaten: Z. Wheatley (DB tackler and forced fumble; not beaten)

plays.description: Completes a dump-off inside the 30 to the 28; receiver is not explicitly identified.
Catches Young's deep-right pass for 26 yards to the Atlanta 5. Commentary says he had plenty of room. DB also records roughing the passer.
On third-and-goal, tries to create a play himself before throwing incomplete toward Jalen Coker.
Catches a wide-open 3-yard touchdown pass from Young.
Play fake to Robinson followed by commentary mentioning Drake London; the pass result is missing.
Quick-drop pass is tipped and intercepted. DB identifies Bobby Okereke as the interceptor, Devin Lloyd with the deflection, and Bijan Robinson as the intended receiver; return gains 3 yards.
On third-and-15, pressure hits Young and causes the ball to flail away; final ruling is not stated.
Rush targets Pitts; Jaycee Horn slaps the ball away.
Returns Atlanta's punt down the sideline with a flag down. DB records a 36-yard return and an Atlanta illegal-formation penalty.
Commentary identifies Legette during a preceding play fragment; action and result are absent.
Under edge pressure, throws incomplete to Legette in the corner from the Atlanta 19. Commentary credits Henderson's coverage.
plays.defender_beaten: Henderson (credited with good coverage; not beaten)

plays.description: Attempts a 37-yard field goal; DB confirms it is good.
A slant is called from shotgun; receiver and result are missing. Captions call the backfield player Brian Robinson, but the identity cannot be resolved from this fragment.
Run gets close to another first down; surrounding commentary calls it Atlanta's longest play.
Atlanta goes for a conversion with a reverse. Carolina reads it and stops it; commentary credits the linebackers and names Devin Lloyd.
plays.defender_beaten: Devin Lloyd (credited with stop; not beaten)

plays.description: Quarterback is thrown down for an apparent sack; commentary names Dexter among the defenders. Carolina possession is inferred from the surrounding sequence.
Makes a catch; distance and spot are omitted.
Commentary references another big stop by Devin Lloyd; the offensive action and yardage are missing.
plays.defender_beaten: Devin Lloyd (credited with stop; not beaten)

plays.description: Catches Young's third-down pass beyond the 35 to the 37 for a first down.
Catches a 27-yard pass from Young to the Atlanta 36.
Caption fragment places the ball at the Atlanta 11. In the supplied sequence, this matches Coker's 25-yard reception; captions omit his name and the catch call.
Makes a spin move, rolls left and throws incomplete toward McMillan.
Makes a 25-yard field goal to finish the drive.
Under pressure on third-and-2, tries to make a play and reaches the sticks. Captions do not establish whether this was a scramble or a pass.
Catches a pass from Rush. The isolated word 'screen' does not clearly describe this play.
Runs through the left side on first-and-10.
Catches a crossing route on third down, struggles to keep his balance and falls forward to the 42.
Runs for a first down to the 29.
On third-and-4 just outside the 20, commentary calls an interception. No supplied DB turnover matches this point in the sequence; the subsequent score reference is 13-3.
The kicker-age and 13-3 score fragment aligns with Atlanta's 41-yard field goal in the DB; the actual kick call is absent.
Catches a seam pass against an inside blitz from a five-wide alignment. A flag is down; enforcement and final play status are not stated.
Jonathon Brooks stays in to block, but Young is sacked.
Wide open for a 55-yard reception to the Atlanta 10. Mike Hughes makes the touchdown-saving tackle.
Catches Young's 7-yard touchdown throw to the corner on third-and-goal. Commentary praises the coverage, throw and route.
plays.concept: short pass right; pass to corner

plays.description: Returns the second-half kickoff to the Carolina 27.
Catches a third-and-12 pass initially described as a yard short. Subsequent commentary says the ruling is reversed to a first down.
Brief Hubbard play reference follows the first-down reversal; action and result are missing.
Makes a catch against a blitz for 28 yards to the Atlanta 24. Commentary praises both catch and throw.
Ballcarrier has open grass ahead and is marked at the 18. Captions do not identify the player or distinguish a run from a reception.
Catches a 12-yard touchdown pass, his second touchdown of the day.
With Brooks beside him in shotgun, Young throws incomplete under pressure. Dexter gets a hand in.
Pass intended for Dotson is tipped and intercepted by Devin Lloyd, who returns it 16 yards for a Carolina touchdown. DB credits Jaycee Horn with the deflection.
Catches Strand's dump-off, stays on his feet and reaches midfield.
Commentary describes a sack by an outside linebacker coming off the edge; defender's name is missing.
On third-and-12 against pressure, completes a crossing pass. Ransom is immediately on the receiver.
Lone-setback play reaches the 15; the captions do not explicitly state whether Hubbard runs or receives.
Commentators praise a nicely set-up play and note a player is slow to get up. Action and player identities are absent; Carolina possession is inferred from sequence.
Catches Strand's dump-off for a first down.
Scrambles for a first down inside the 40.
Reaches the 26; announcer corrects an initial call of the 16. Play type is not stated.
Steps up against edge pressure and targets Hooper. Will Lee makes the defensive play; context indicates an incompletion.
plays.defender_beaten: Will Lee (credited with defensive play; not beaten)

plays.description: Misses a long field goal. Commentary calls it 54 yards; authoritative DB records 53 yards, wide right.
Commentary says a player will touch the ball while discussing rest for Bijan Robinson; action and outcome are missing.
Catches Strand's underneath checkdown against edge pressure at the 46.
Carolina recovers a fumble. DB identifies a 6-yard sack of Strand followed by A. Hall's recovery at the Atlanta 46.

offense_strengths: Young repeatedly found McMillan: three DB-matched gains of 26, 27 and 28 yards, plus a captioned third-down conversion.
Explosive passing included Coker's 25-yard gain and Legette's 55-yard reception.
Hubbard scored on a wide-open short pass; Waller caught touchdown passes of 7 and 12 yards.
McMillan's 28-yard reception came against an explicitly called blitz.
Two first-half drives ended in short field goals after incomplete passes near the end zone.
defense_weaknesses: Atlanta gained first downs through London's crossing reception, Robinson's rushing and Hooper's dump-off.
Strand escaped for a first-down scramble inside the 40.
Robinson gained to midfield after a dump-off while staying on his feet.

offense_strengths: Bijan Robinson produced a left-side run and a separate first-down run to the 29.
London's crossing route and underneath completions to Pitts, Robinson and Hooper supplied gains.
Strand added a first down with his legs.
defense_weaknesses: Allowed McMillan's three matched receptions of at least 26 yards and Legette's 55-yard gain.
Commentary explicitly described Hubbard as far too open on his touchdown and Legette as wide open on the long reception.
Allowed Waller two touchdown receptions, including a third-and-goal score before halftime.
A called blitz did not prevent McMillan's 28-yard catch on Carolina's third-quarter touchdown drive.

limitations: Captions only; no routes, blocking, leverage, personnel counts or coverage shells were inferred visually. The early prediction of frequent 12/13 personnel was not assigned to a specific snap. Shotgun and other formations were entered only when commentary explicitly stated them, even when DB text supplied shotgun. Named tacklers do not establish who was responsible for coverage or beaten; their roles are labeled. Yards are gains for offensive plays, return distances for returns, and kick distances for field goals; null means unavailable. Teams on return plays identify the kicking/offensive team as requested. Some fragments lack enough information to establish a complete play, and two possession assignments are explicitly identified as sequence-based inferences. The apparent interception at 06:31 conflicts with the supplied DB sequence and remains unmatched. The 09:03–09:44 Jets/Williams segment appears to be unrelated game commentary and was excluded. No caption passage reliably identifies the DB's Q3 7:13 Lloyd interception and 53-yard return, the negated Q2 5:48 London reception, or several listed kickoff returns, so those were not added as observed highlights. Auto-caption uses of Brian/Bijan Robinson were left unresolved where no clear DB match exists. Score flags include defensive return touchdowns.
